patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, impactful imagery or video on one side and concise text blocks on the other, often spanning full width.
Prominent use of a monospaced font for both display headings and small data labels, creating a high-tech, precise aesthetic.
A stark, high-contrast palette featuring a dominant dark background, light gray text, and a single vibrant green accent for interactive elements and key highlights.
The hero section features a background video that parallaxes, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground text and data overlays, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.

Content sections are clearly delineated by full-width dark backgrounds, often with subtle variations in shade, and feature a consistent internal structure of a heading, descriptive text, and supporting visuals or data points.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed video background that scrolls with a parallax effect, moving slower than the overlaying text and interactive elements to create a layered depth. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.

Content sections below the hero likely utilize GSAP ScrollTrigger to reveal elements with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement and guiding the user's attention through the page content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase-leaning monospaced headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, legible body text and very small, monospaced data labels for a technical feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners on all interactive elements, buttons, and card-like containers, reinforcing a precise and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness and allowing content to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a monospaced font for both prominent headings and subtle data labels, combined with a dark, high-contrast palette and a dynamic video hero, creates a unique high-tech, data-driven aesthetic that feels both sophisticated and precise. The integration of technical data overlays directly into the hero video is particularly striking.
